briefing: An Iran-blamed drone strike in Kuwait killed two Italian technicians, and Congo's Ebola outbreak passed 12,000 confirmed cases. Nvidia paused server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries over export rules, and X added parental controls for teens. A federal judge ruled the FCC's pressure on ABC licenses violated free speech, and Norse Atlantic suspended all flights. In Idaho, over 60,000 seniors face canceled Medicare Advantage plans.
